title: Hydroxyl radical generation in peroxymonocarbonate/Co2+ systems: kinetic and mechanistic insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43965-43973
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06308F, Paper
Open Access

Thi Tinh Vu, Ngoc Duy Vu, Thi Bich Viet Nguyen
˙OH radicals are efficiently produced in the PMC/Co2+ system via a Fenton-like pathway confirmed by TA probing. The reaction exhibits first-order kinetics with respect to [TA], Langmuir-type dependence on [PMC], and linear dependence on [Co2+].
